text:
lisa: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hybrid & office ops. Dropping clarifications here so folks can find them.

tom: Two quick asks: 1) Can I bring a partner to the team dinner at the offsite? 2) Is there a short-term work-from-another-city approval?

ana: Guests allowed only for informal regional socials. Not allowed for strategy retreats or customer events. If you want to bring a partner, get manager pre-approval and it's self-pay unless approved otherwise.

lisa: Work-from-another-city (US <14 days): submit Remote Location Request 3 business days ahead. Cross-border needs finance/legal review.

people-ops-bot: Policy note uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/policies/offsite_hybrid_short (edited)

matt: Hoteling conflicts still happening. Any interim fix?

lisa: New hoteling rollout next sprint. Interim rule: meetings > recurring desks > one-off hoteling. If conflict, ping #desk-ops with screenshot and ops will reconcile.

tom: Per diems for meals? international vs domestic?

lisa: Domestic offsites: $65/day meals. International: country-specific per diem in the policy doc. Always keep receipts for non-per diem expenses.

cto: Leadership note: For Dedicated/private infra visits, request security clearance 72 hours before. No same-day approvals.

ana: Are speaker honoraria / external presenter travel paid?

lisa: If presenter is non-employee, travel can be covered with prior approval and PO. Speaker honoraria must go through finance and be pre-cleared.

tom: Any emergency travel fund for last-minute family issues?

lisa: Case-by-case via manager + people-ops. We try to be flexible; keep receipts and manager note.

people-ops-bot: FAQ draft added to all-hands follow-ups: https://intranet.redwood/allhands/faq_jul2026 (edited)

lisa: Thanks everyone 10. I'll post a one-pager and flowchart by end of week. DM me for edge cases.
